recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-47738 unless the work group reopens the child-name choice or changes Requirements.imports semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-47738 was Applied as Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Requirements. It requested a way for a Requirements instance to import or point forward to external requirement statements, so referenced IG requirements can apply without being copied or redefined locally.
initial_application: Upstream commit ccc7c77def added Requirements.imports with a canonical-valued child and a repeating key child to source/requirements/structuredefinition-Requirements.xml. Adjacent commit 88c7b5ba for FHIR-47737 then normalized the canonical-valued child name to reference, producing the current Requirements.imports.reference shape.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2024-10-28 record the Requirements.imports disposition and 10-0-0 vote. A 2025-02-28 Zulip implementation note from Grahame Grieve explains that related Requirements tasks proposed different names for canonical-valued children and he made them all reference. The active Requirements resource remains in build scope through source/fhir.ini; related FHIR-47736 and FHIR-47739 reconciliations are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current StructureDefinition defines Requirements.imports 0..*, Requirements.imports.reference 1..1 canonical to Requirements, and Requirements.imports.key 0..* id with the approved short, definition, and comments.

related_jiras.note: Its application commit normalized Requirements canonical-valued child names to reference, including imports.reference. It was used as context but not independently decided here because the actor-link request is distinct from FHIR-47738.
It governs related statement reference mechanics and is already represented on the combined branch by commit d0f58248c0a17c61a24d763a95acaa75410a24d1.
It clarified derivedFrom versus partOf semantics and is already represented on the combined branch by commit 54a82c19976ceca4ff7c4fd01ffabb0c94c0ff55.
